app_store.name: I-Dementia: Golden Moments
app_store.subtitle: Imisebenzi yezithombe elula
app_store.promotional_text: Imisebenzi elula yokujabulela ndawonye: amakhadi amakhulu, izithombe zomndeni, akukho sibali sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Nesikhumbuzi esikhethwa nina. Akukho akhawunti.
app_store.description:
Funani umsebenzi olula wokujabulela ndawonye. I-Golden Moments inikeza ukufanisa izithombe okuthambile nokubuka izithombe ndawonye emindenini nakubanakekeli, kuhlanganise nalabo abachitha isikhathi nomuntu ophila ne-dementia noma isifo i-Alzheimer's. I-Golden Moments iyatholakala ngesiZulu.

Qalani kancane
Qalani ngamakhadi amane amakhulu nezithombe zokuqala ezijwayelekile. Shiyani izithombe ziyabonakala, noma nizifihle uma kubonakala kufanele. Imodi ethambile ayinasibali sikhathi, amaphuzu noma isijeziso. Khethani amakhadi angu-4, 6, 8 noma 12 njengoba kunjalo.

Yenzeni ibe yenu
Khethani izithombe zomndeni ngesikhethi sezithombe sedivayisi yenu. I-Golden Moments igcina amakhophi amancane emisebenzini esebenza kule divayisi; ayiskeni ilabhulali yenu futhi ayishintshi izithombe zenu zangempela. Beka izithombe ezifinyelela kwezingu-24 eqoqweni elilodwa.

Bukani ndawonye nje
Bukani isithombe esisodwa ngesikhathi. Imibuzo yengxoxo eyikhetho imema ukukhuluma ngaphandle kokucela muntu ukuthi akhumbule amagama noma aphendule ngempendulo efanele. Ukubuka nje kwanele.

Ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi lapho kudingeka
Izithombe zokuqala ziyatholakala ngokushesha. Amakhophi ezithombe ezengeziwe asebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi ngemva kokungezwa. Ukukhetha izithombe zangempela ezigcinwe ku-iCloud kuphela kungadinga ukuxhumeka ku-inthanethi. Wonke amaphakethe ayisishiyagalombili ezithombe afakiwe ku-app, akudingeki ukulanda izithombe ngokwehlukana.

Akukho akhawunti noma iseva yokuvumelanisa izithombe
Amakhophi ezithombe zomndeni ahlala ku-app kule divayisi. Ningasusa amakhophi ngaphandle kokusula izithombe zangempela. Ama-backup edivayisi angafaka idatha ye-app. Le nguqulo ayivumelanisi izithombe phakathi kwezihlobo.

I-Golden Moments iyokuzilibazisa nengxoxo yokwabelana. Ayihloli isifo, ayelapheli, ayivimbi futhi ayilinganisi i-dementia noma isifo i-Alzheimer's. Imisebenzi ayifanele wonke umuntu; landelani lokho umuntu akuthandayo nokumnethezayo, futhi nimise noma niguqule umsebenzi uma kudingeka.
app_store.release_notes:
I-Golden Moments manje iyatholakala ngezilimi eziningi, kuhlanganise nesiZulu, iSpanishi, iPutukezi, isiFulentshi, isiJalimani, isiJapane, isiKorea, isiShayina, isiArabhu, isiHindi nezinye. I-app ilandela ulimi lwefoni yenu, futhi amaphakethe ezithombe nezihloko zazo nazo zihunyushiwe.
Lokhu kuhunyushwa kusha futhi akukabuyekezwa ngabakhuluma ulimi ngokwemvelo. Uma kukhona okufundeka kabi, sitshelani ngokuya ku-Usizo nobumfihlo.
